title: The same crossing with an R-KERF fact, h_r = 0.5 mm: the engraving is ignored
rationale: With R-KERF open (rung R8k) and recesses shallower than h_r = 0.5 mm ignored, the 0.3 mm engraving is no keep-out (safety-model 7.5). The project design's case list says h_r >= 0.3, while safety-model 7.5 ignores recesses 'shallower than h_r' (so h_r = 0.3 would not lift a 0.3 mm recess); the case uses 0.5 mm, which lifts it under both readings. Only the lifting of W-SURF is asserted.
